card.title: IPhone XS No Image on Screen

source.title: IPhone XS No Image on Screen

claims.statement: iPhone XS / XS Max (OLED, so not 'backlight') no image is most often blown PP3V0_DISPLAY_CONN filter FL5783 at J5700; otherwise pry-damaged chokes L5700/L5710/L5720/L5730/L5740 or long-screw damage near the battery connector.

procedure: Replace FL5783 or damaged chokes; check the screw hole.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
